title: Flatness from a same-universe filtered colimit presentation
statement: Let R be a commutative ring in Type w, J a small filtered category in Type w, M an object of ModuleCat.{w} R, and P a colimit presentation of M indexed by J. If every P.diag.obj j is flat over R [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then M is flat over R. A colimit presentation is a diagram with a cocone of vertex M whose cocone is a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: ModuleCat.flat_of_colimitPresentation, lines 57-81; existing proof of Stacks 05UT by exactness of filtered colimits

proof.text: Use Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_preserves_shortComplex_exact. For an exact short complex C, form the short complex of J-diagrams whose three terms are pres.diag tensor C.X_k. The arrows are obtained by whiskering the curried tensor functor maps of C.f and C.g. Their composite is zero by C.zero and functoriality. Evaluation at each j is exact by Module.Flat.lTensor_shortComplex_exact and the given flatness hypothesis. The diagram short complex is exact by ShortComplex.exact_iff_evaluation.

Tensoring on the right preserves the three colimit cocones of pres by [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-commutes-with-colimits]. Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.colim.exact_mapShortComplex using exactness of filtered colimits in ModuleCat (ModuleCat.AB). The compatibility equations are the whisker_exchange identities. Thus tensoring C on the left with M is exact, which gives flatness. The cited existing Lean declaration is already completely proved, with no sorry.
